assumptions.assumption: Cloud build means Aura storage plus a local workbench.
assumptions.impact: Does not imply hosted application or production deployment.

assumptions.assumption: Rules are curated interpretation and source-contract paraphrases.
assumptions.impact: They are not universal executable causal rules.

assumptions.assumption: Current workbench incidents are preserved public development snapshots.
assumptions.impact: This run does not establish live-snapshot GraphRAG integration.

assumptions.assumption: Service/operation matching plus lexical overlap is sufficient for a first retrieval demo.
assumptions.impact: Not multilingual semantic search, full-platform coverage, or a retrieval-precision result.

assumptions.assumption: The source revision need not match the observed runtime.
assumptions.impact: Static source contracts remain context, not observed execution or root-cause evidence.

assumptions.assumption: A valid reference ID means the claim is supported.
assumptions.impact: gRPC 13 is not contained in the claim's cited records; support needs a separate review.

assumptions.assumption: A shortened condition preserves the full source contract.
assumptions.impact: HTTP422 mapping loses exception predicates; preserve the source condition and missing-runtime-details caveat.

assumptions.assumption: Query return ordering is a stable packet identity.
assumptions.status: repaired in code; offline reversal probe passes
assumptions.impact: Canonical ordering is necessary to avoid duplicate logical requests consuming extra attempts.

assumptions.assumption: Namespaced upsert completely synchronizes knowledge revisions.
assumptions.impact: Base topology remains an upsert. Treat this namespace as frozen and use an explicit new version for changed topology.

assumptions.assumption: Builder hash validation is automatically enforced at import and retrieval.
assumptions.status: import repaired and independently reprobed; retrieval still trusts owned namespace
assumptions.impact: Repeated fake import rejects stale-hash text before a write. A future shared/editable cloud namespace needs retrieval-side integrity validation.

assumptions.assumption: Three successful retrieval questions establish general retrieval quality.
assumptions.impact: Three selected questions over one previously inspected incident do not measure diagnosis accuracy, precision, or held-out generalization.

assumptions.assumption: Selecting a free-tier-listed model proves zero cost for this key/project.
assumptions.impact: No paid fallback is configured, but serviceTier=standard and token usage do not certify billing at zero.

assumptions.assumption: Service error-span rates identify request-level status and propagation direction.
assumptions.impact: They count error-marked spans per second over an aggregate window; individual spans/parent IDs supply different evidence.

assumptions.assumption: The cloud query's data is immutable or trusted forever.
assumptions.impact: Hash checks can detect stale retrieval text but do not replace ownership, provenance review, or a corpus snapshot manifest.

assumptions.assumption: Live documentation URLs preserve the reviewed text.
assumptions.impact: Web-source reviews are dated; no immutable web snapshot or independent reviewer web revalidation was performed.

assumptions.assumption: Model use stays bounded across this build.
assumptions.status: observed five attempts within a six-attempt ledger: three failures and two accepted responses
assumptions.impact: All three failures remain retained. A distinct ledger would create a separate authorization/accounting domain and must not be used to evade the cap.

assumptions.assumption: Same-family independent review certifies clean results.
assumptions.impact: Review is provisional simulated scrutiny with unresolved semantic defects and untested broader properties.

assumptions.assumption: The payment service has a database dependency worth checking.
assumptions.status: not established by narrower UI packet
assumptions.impact: Inspect actual deployed dependencies first; a generic database check must be conditional.

assumptions.assumption: Every review finding refers to a numbered claim.
assumptions.status: invalid for the database next-check finding; display repair requested
assumptions.impact: Use section and item index. Null claim index must not render as Claim 1.

assumptions.assumption: Optional review JSON always has the expected shape.
assumptions.impact: A malformed annotation must not crash or rewrite an already completed model answer.

assumptions.assumption: Truthful transcribed cloud tables satisfy an actual-screenshot coursework requirement.
assumptions.impact: Prior review AI-KG-4 records actual Neo4j KG/query screenshots as required; preserve scoped actual captures or designate the new deck as an extension companion.
